capabilities: Search D&D 5e monsters, spells, and items from the command palette
Insert formatted entries at the cursor
Generate statblock YAML compatible with Fantasy Statblocks
Render inline spell and item cards in reading view
Cache compendium data locally and choose which sources are searched
extras: Desktop-only because it uses Node.js filesystem APIs for caching; downloads compendium JSON from raw.githubusercontent.com and writes cache files into its plugin folder; no account, telemetry, or ads.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search official 5e game content and insert it as formatted, plugin-compatible statblocks and item/spell cards.

relations.evidence: Monster inserts are designed to work especially well with the Obsidian TTRPG Community plugins
added to a bestiary, added to the initiative tracker, and used for rolling HP
used for rolling HP, attacks, and other supported rolls directly from the card

summary: Searches and inserts Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition monsters, spells, and items into notes, generating statblock YAML for TTRPG plugins.
